text.offer: Brax lies beneath the ancient place south of here. Its Queen sealed it with a lift: raise the four outer pillars and light all five, and the platform will lift you to the way down. The nine levers at the south end of it do the work, each as its label says, and the Watcher's journal beside them tells you how. Find the Winding Caverns beneath, and come back to me.
text.progress: The ancient place lies just south of the Cragged Mountains. Raise the four outer pillars with their levers, then light all five, ride the platform, and find the Winding Caverns below.
text.complete: You found the way. Then you are ready for what lies in Brax - and there is a great deal of it.

steps.objective: Find the ancient place south of the Cragged Mountains
Raise and light the pillars, and find the Winding Caverns
steps.brief: This is the place. Read the Watcher's journal by the levers if you like, but it comes to this: pull the four Raise/Lower levers to raise the outer pillars, then the five Light levers. The platform rises a moment later and comes down again after two minutes, so be ready to ride it.
